spans.s: नियतकाल a. limited in time, temporary.

नियतव्रत a. firm in one's vow or faith, faithful,
pious.
नियतात्मन् a. self-controlled.
नियताहार a. restricting one's food.

नियतेन्द्रिय a. having one's organs or passions
restrained.
नियन्तव्य a. to be restrained or tamed.
नियन्तृ॑ m. restrainer, tamer, charioteer.
नियन्त्रण n. restraining, confining (also आ f.).
नियमार्थम् adv. for the sake of restriction.
नियमोपमा f. a kind of comparison ((rh.)).
नियम्य a. to be restrained, subdued, limited, or defined.

निया॑न n. coming down, arrival;
 way, path.
नियुक्ति f. injunction, appointment.

नि॑युत a. tied on, fastened;
 n. a million.

नियु॑त्वन्त् a. having a team of horses (E. of sev. Gods);
forming a line or series, i.e. uninterrupted, continual, everlasting.
नियुद्ध n. fight, esp. fistic combat.
नियोगकृत् a. executing a commission.
नियोगार्थ m. the object or purpose of an appointment.
